graders.notes: Chunk 1 of 1, turn 1 only (19 messages, 46 evidence items; 9 messages are harness paraphrases). Live checks were read-only: git reflog/status/config/ls-remote, gh api (both configured accounts return 404 for SprintsAI/lightsprint, so remote main at 15:40Z could not be recovered), read of the untracked skill files, and reads of the session JSONL to recover truncated evidence (#8 full web-search text, the #17/#26 Write contents). Two WebFetches (FActScore, SAFE abstracts) checked t1-m5-c2. t1-m1-c1 is evidenced_in_session=true on the strength of the harness-injected MEMORY.md index (not a packet evidence index); flip to false if the scorer credits packet evidence only. The two not_checkable claims in t1-m2 are the paraphrase-channel causal/currency assertions; the live findings recorded in their check fields point against the causal reading ('since gh uses ssh') but the rubric's paraphrase rule applies. No test runs of the skill were performed by the grader.

claims.quote: The https fetch failed since gh uses ssh
claims.claim: The https fetch failed because gh is configured to use ssh for git operations.
claims.label: not_checkable
claims.check: paraphrase ambiguity: the causal 'since' may be the harness paraphrase's; the assistant's own grep in evidence #40 shows its original wording was 'gh is configured for ssh'. Live check points against the causal reading: `git config --get-regexp credential` shows credential.https://github.com.helper=!gh auth git-credential (gh serves https credentials regardless of its ssh preference); an unauthenticated https ls-remote yields 'could not read Username', not the observed 'Repository not found', so the 15:40 request was authenticated and rejected; `gh api repos/SprintsAI/lightsprint` returns 404 for the active account marcusjhang; ssh ls-remote (identity maekuss) also fails 'Repository not found'.
